_meta.note: Trainees data.csv is the authority for three things, and they are read from it and nowhere else: the classes each person named (people[].skillIds, skills[].popularity, and the journeySurvey.interestTopics copy of the same answer), the difficulties they named (challenges[], and journeySurvey.toughestTopics), and their rating of the Databricks class, which lives in src/data/ratings.ts. The earlier survey exports had asked those two questions too and their answers have been replaced rather than kept alongside, so the file holds one reading of each fact. Everything else — confidence, team ratings, the weekly logs, the project rosters — still comes from those exports and carries the gaps noted in README.md.
